paragraphs: It was only this year that he'd visit the Qian family. Since they'd just started working together, a little pretense was necessary.
Besides, the thought of him fucking the Qian family's patriarch's wife made him feel a bit elated. It was nice, sure, but what was wrong with fucking someone else's wife?
Zhao An didn't take the compliment in stride. Instead, he let out a disdainful smile. "True wealthy people don't care about these so-called rankings. Do you think the Rothschilds care about them?"

Huang Meng's tactics were indeed despicable. He deliberately ordered food and then claimed it was infested with bugs or unclean, even going so far as to send people to the hospital. His goal was to disgust the platform while simultaneously smearing and defaming it on a massive scale.
Dong! Dong! Dong! Zhao An's fingers tapped the tea table. "What do you think?"

"I heard from the people at Hengdu that you're a genius. Your name will definitely be on the Forbes rich list someday," Qian Ben complimented, half-jokingly. Everyone wants to work with a genius, they just don't have the channels.

This kind of situation only treats the symptoms, not the root cause. The only effective solution is for you to take the lion's share. Other companies and platforms take the smaller share. Eating the meat while giving the opponent the soup? Impossible, but footbath water is acceptable.

"Talk to him, or ask a third party to intervene. This is simply vicious competition and illegal!" Qian Ben hadn't been paying much attention. The Qian and Huang families weren't on the same level, and just dealing with Huang Meng alone was already a bit overwhelming.
The advantage of being a middleman is that they can easily get away with it, without a trace of responsibility.

"That's thoughtful. The logistics channels have always been smooth. The Fang family had originally begun developing land-based logistics and transportation channels, but they temporarily stopped. I heard something happened to the Huang family's second young master." Qian Ben poured a cup of tea and gestured for a drink.

He couldn't take action now; if he did, suspicion would be cast upon him. It's annoying for someone so wealthy and powerful to encounter someone who's unafraid of wearing shoes. And his status as the second young master of the Huang family also protected him from assassination.

"I was just giving you a heads-up. Huang Meng has become even more treacherous this time. He's resorting to all sorts of tactics, and his despicable tactics are becoming increasingly sinister." Qian Ben was a little dissatisfied. This was a case of swatting the rabbits while swatting the grass, and it was affecting him as well.

"Congratulations on your prosperity, congratulations on your prosperity," Zhao An said, also offering a New Year's greeting. The moment he saw the green-haired turtle, he knew they would become close friends. Since they were friends, it made sense to help take care of the other's wife, a duty he couldn't refuse.
"Then why don't you send someone to remove his oxygen tube? Put an end to it all." Zhao An smiled, took a sip from his teacup.
The room was a little dull. Neither of them spoke, and the atmosphere felt awkward.
After landing, a car picked him up; everything was perfectly arranged.
"To me, money is meaningless. Only by converting it into cash and making my life better, that's what matters." Zhao An lit a herbal cigarette, his eyes filled with disdain.
"The Huang family is just going to let it go, right?" Zhao An tapped his fingers, a thoughtful expression on his face.
Qian Ben nodded. "Yes, the Huang family is pretending to be ignorant of these matters."

"He's not the heir to the Huang family, so naturally, he doesn't need to worry about his image. He's just a mad dog. Young Master An, we have to find a way to retaliate. Otherwise, being so passive is not a solution!" Qian Ben began to plead for help. Such despicable tactics were no fun if they were repeated too often. Eventually, something bad would happen.
It wouldn't have no impact, but for the platform, the most they could do was announce follow-up oversight procedures and terminate their partnership with the offending restaurant. That's it.
"I'm honored to have you here, Zhao An. Please come this way," Qian Ben said, smiling and inviting him, personally making him some tea.
If it happened once or twice, it would be fine, but with five or six orders coming in every day, how could they continue this kind of thing?

It was simply because the logistics industry was profitable; it was practically a ready-made business. Just invest the manpower and resources, and if the online channels could supply enough goods, there was profit to be made.

"Haha, the Fang and Huang families are behemoths, not dogs. No matter who wants to fight my Qian family, we will fight to the bitter end!" Qian Ben wasn't afraid now. The Qian family came from coal mining families, and developing industries was to avoid being squeezed out in the future when resources were depleted.
"Then we'll take it back. We'll do the same as Huang Meng did." Zhao An blew out a smoke ring and began to make up his mind.

"Haha, that's right. They're truly wealthy, living in seclusion. They don't care about this empty reputation," Qian Ben replied with a grin. Only after reaching a certain level of status would one realize there's something else in the world.
"This... this will hurt both sides, right?" Qian Ben was also a little frightened. If everyone acted recklessly, it would easily cause trouble.
"The Huang family still hasn't expressed their stance, right?" Zhao An asked again.

"That's a good thing. God has a way of letting them fight each other. That's good." Zhao An wouldn't admit that all this had anything to do with him, and no one would have thought it. After all, he had a perfect alibi. The occasional livestream from home proved he had never left his hometown.

"I'm not interested in these things. Investing and earning dividends is more practical." Zhao An took a sip from his teacup. After his sexual encounters with Qian Yuling and Tang Yin on the plane, he looked particularly exhausted. It was as if he'd been drained dry by two vixen, and needed some refueling.

"I heard recently that Huang Meng has become quite successful, and the food delivery platform Chimo has also started. They're copying your tactics, so you might want to be careful," Qian Ben warned. This level wasn't within his reach. Rather, this part of the business wasn't within his reach; he was only responsible for transportation.

"Sometimes, replicating a successful example isn't always possible, but I'm not worried at all. You have to understand that monopolies are both profitable and dangerous. Having a rival to challenge you can be a good warning and motivate you to improve." Zhao An knew that if he eliminated one Chimo, there would be another, like Chimo.

"The Huang family doesn't care if the market order is disrupted, so what are you afraid of? Kind people are often bullied, and kind horses are often ridden. Just think about it." Suffering in silence was not Zhao An's style.

A doctor with twenty years of service would certainly trust the other person, even if they were a Korean. "Mr. Zhao, please sit down."
Lin Dongsheng nodded. "Thank you. It's a small gift. Please accept it." He handed over a check.

"Having you in the Bai family is truly a great blessing. Since Young Master Zhao doesn't need you, I'll keep it for you. Come back when you need it later." Lin Dongsheng didn't mince words, but instead offered a few compliments. Despite the man's unpleasant, even harsh, tone, he didn't really have any ill intentions.

As for eccentricity, aren't geniuses always known for their eccentricities?

"Alright, there's nothing to be polite about. I have nothing to say to you." Zhao An waved his hand, the guest actually expelling the host.

Lin Yuanyuan personally boiled the herbs, stewing them in a simmer over firewood to raise the temperature.

In the room, Zhao An inserted the needles with swift speed, each time precisely targeting the desired area. As the capsule Madam Lin had already swallowed quickly digested, her complexion improved.

"Lin Yuanyuan, bring the herbs I instructed and cook them here. Remember, use firewood!" Zhao An took out an alcohol lamp, lit it, and began to disinfect the silver needles. He also took out a capsule and gave it to the elderly woman. He undressed and began acupuncture.
Acupuncture stimulates acupuncture points, allowing the body to continue functioning even when unconscious. This ensures the body remains in a healthy state of vitality, thus combating illness.
Zhao An waved his hand. "No need. It'll take a while tonight, and we'll be done. Just eat and recuperate."
An elderly woman, her skin the color of a withered tree, lay unconscious on the bed, breathing more out than in, looking seriously ill.
Half an hour later, Zhao An left the room. "Don't go in," he said. He took out a pill, opened the lid of the pot, and dropped it in.

He spoke as if he weren't a pervert. You know, Zhao An also really liked married women. Especially those in their thirties and forties, full of mature charm, who were the most satisfying to fuck. paragraphs: "Keep interrogating him. He has other accomplices. We can't let these bastards run wild this time." Lin Yuanyuan laid bare her plan without holding anything back.
Zhao An stroked his chin. "That sounds quite satisfying. It would be even better if they were a little more ruthless!"

"They'll pay the price. The Tang family wasn't worth much last time. This time, it's different. They'll pay the price in blood." A hint of murderous intent flashed in Lin Yuanyuan's eyes. These bastards, toying with someone else's wife and bearing children, using someone else's body as a substitute, were simply too much. They must pay the price.

Lin Kaixuan's heart sank. He was a smiling tiger, to be sure, but the man before him looked more like a demon. A true demon, a demon with bared fangs! "Of course, of course." Cold sweat broke out on his forehead. This was a bit too frightening.

"So urgent? Okay, I'll be prepared. Thank you, truly, Zhao An. You've saved our Lin family, and it's no exaggeration to say you've saved it." Lin Yuanyuan's expression was incredibly sincere; she was truly grateful to Zhao An. As long as Old Madam Lin wasn't dead, her network of connections would still exist. And she had stood tall against the Koreans. With a single word from the old woman, the family line was cut short. Who could withstand such a thing?

Zhao An's eyes lit up, and he shook his hand. "If you're talking about that, I won't be sleepy anymore. You're much smarter than your eldest brother. Tsk, what did your eldest brother say? Give me five hundred million! That's hilarious! Do I need five hundred million? I make tens of millions a minute. I wouldn't care about a billion or eight hundred million."

"He hasn't returned to the Bai family yet. It's said he declined Bai Qiuqin's invitation. He doesn't need to return to the Bai family; he can still expand his career without relying on their channels." Lin Yuanyuan had also researched Zhao An; he was indeed a very talented person, and still very young.

Lin Kaixuan's smile widened. "My brother is the head of the family. He's also very good at maintaining his reputation." Normal. Haha, that's a deal, An Shao. Be sure to call me when the time comes so I can thank you properly."

Madam Lin smiled without answering, her eyes tinged with kindness. "You're truly special. That's what I admire most about you. Xiaoyuan, no one would dare arrange a marriage for you while Grandma is still alive. Try to find a suitable husband before Grandma dies. Zheng Peiling and her daughter are truly remarkable. They're both very clever and resourceful."
Madam Lin nodded, her complexion rosy. "Good, much better. Xiaoyuan, have you arranged accommodations for Dr. Zhao?"

"Grandma, no one can say for sure about this kind of thing. Besides, he's not a good man. Zhao An is very lustful. He has many women around him, and many of them are already pregnant with his children." Lin Yuanyuan would not be happy to marry such a man. She didn't ask for him to be particularly good, but at least he shouldn't be so promiscuous.

"I heard he beat up Lin Nu? That matter was just passed over. Since he's a guest, we should treat him well." Madam Lin naturally sided with the doctor who saved her life, and didn't need to ask about the process.
"Grandma, are you feeling better?" Lin Yuanyuan asked as she entered.

"Okay, remember to leave me any good stuff. By the way, virgins, celebrities, beautiful women—anything's fine. Just don't play dirty. I can tell if they've been used before. A businessman once sent me women whose hymens he'd restored after giving them blowjobs, and I sent them both away. As for whether God forgives them or not, that's God's business. What I hate most is deception. If it doesn't work, then it doesn't work. It won't kill you!"
"I understand, I understand," Lin Yuanyuan thanked him heartily. Her grandmother's survival was truly important to her.

"One more thing, don't spread the news that I cured cancer. I don't want to save anyone else. Your grandmother was lucky. Qian Yuling's mother asked, and I gave her a favor. I'm not sure I'll be able to do that next time." Zhao An smiled and waved his hand. To be rich and talented, yet still save lives, that was a bit outrageous.

Meeting him was the smiling tiger Lin Kaixuan, who stepped forward. "Young Master An, you're truly a genius! Not only are you proficient in business, but you're also a master of medicine. Amazing! Truly amazing! Please let me know next time you have time. I'll invite Young Master An to the Renjian Club for a visit. I guarantee you'll be satisfied."
However, the precise surgery and calculations made Zhao An's entire experience seem a bit like a dream, an incredible dream!

"Yes, Father has already taken care of the matter." Lin Yuanyuan lowered her head, not expressing any opinion of Zhao An. "What if you marry him? What do you think? Grandma can't protect you forever. You need a man who can. Marriage is the most important thing in a woman's life. Marrying a bad man is crucial, so marrying a good man is key." Old Madam Lin said earnestly. As someone who had experienced this, she naturally knew what was most important.

"I'm looking forward to the day they're in trouble. Let's leave it this way for now. I'll go to the Bai family and come back later for another acupuncture session. It should be enough." Zhao An said, and then he called Bai Qiuqin to get up and set off together.
"What do you think of Dr. Zhao? He's still so young, even younger than you. The Bai family is truly blessed to have such an outstanding descendant," Madam Lin sighed.
"Grandma! You won't die," Lin Yuanyuan said coquettishly. She had a deep bond with Grandma and couldn't bear to see her go.
The group left the Lin residence, and Lin Yuanyuan went to Old Madam Lin's room.

Old Madam Lin was in good spirits. The cancer cells were actually cured by medication, and acupuncture only accelerated the process. Besides, nutritional capsules are used to supplement nutrients, and only Zhao An would use this method. It's too dangerous. If not handled properly, it could be fatal. Even a young man in his prime would struggle to handle such a situation, let alone an elderly woman.
"Yes, Grandma. Don't worry, I'll treat him well." Lin Yuanyuan poured Madam Lin a glass of water.

"Silly child, everyone dies eventually. It doesn't matter how many men you have, as long as you find one who treats you well. As long as a man loves you, nothing else matters." Madam Lin caressed her granddaughter's head lovingly. She didn't want to die, but she didn't want her life to drag down the entire family. Paying such a huge price just to heal herself was clearly unwise!

paragraphs: "Grandma, you won't die. You'll be fine!" Lin Yuanyuan wasn't happy to hear this news. "Grandma, Zhao An said he'll come back later to continue your acupuncture."
"Yes, I see. That kid is truly a genius. The old man pushes the new man forward." Old Madam Lin sighed. It was truly the young who ruled the world these days.

Bai Song didn't seem angry. He stroked his beard and said, "Everyone's ideas deserve respect, and yours are certainly reasonable. If you need cooperation in the future, please feel free to contact the Bai family. The Bai family's door to cooperation is always open to you."

"With more money, you can invest in research and development and improve technology. Subsidies in this field are very generous. If you're interested, you can give it a try." Bai Qingyang offered a suggestion: starting a project is nothing more than burning money.
"Dad, this is Zhao An. Zhao An, this is my dad, Bai Song, the head of the Bai family," Bai Qiuqin introduced with a smile. She herself was a very beautiful woman.
Even further down the road, after a half-hour drive, they arrived at a hillside nestled beside a river, boasting a prime location from a feng shui perspective.

"Yes, they're all sissies. What I hate most is men who don't want to be men and choose to be sissies. Or they undergo sex reassignment surgery and become women, which is fine too. Being androgynous makes me sick. And lately, some people are using this trick to copy celebrities and make money. It's really easy money." Zhao An simply disliked sissies.
"Alien blood is disgusting. If it were Zhao An's, it wouldn't matter. The descendants of elites have a high probability of becoming elites themselves."

"It's just so-so. The Bai family mansion has a great location. No wonder they have so many talented people and beautiful scenery. Okay, I have no intention of returning. If you want to work with me, we can discuss it, but the price must be right!" Zhao An made his position clear in a few words. Trying to get something for nothing was unrealistic.
"We'll have a strategy for this. Whatever works is a good method, isn't it?" Bai Qingyang smiled. If some nymphomaniac were here, they'd definitely scream. He's really handsome.

"We've tested them. Don't worry, you'll laugh at us. We caught a few before. After the Tang family incident, we conducted a comprehensive investigation. As for those people, they've vanished from the face of the earth." Bai Qingyang continued to smile, as if killing someone was as simple as killing an animal.

"Okay, I'll take care of it. Mother, do you need any gifts for Zhao An?" Lin Kaixuan asked, his head bowed. Madam Lin didn't answer, but instead asked Lin Yuanyuan, who was standing nearby. "Xiaoyuan, you don't have to stay here with me. Go find Zhao An and see if he needs anything, and we'll get him something."
Zhao An, unfazed, followed Bai Qiuqin into the hall under the gazes of so many people.
"You seem to hate those Koreans," Bai Song suddenly said, as if he had noticed something.

"That's great. We should teach them a lesson." Zhao An took a deep breath, letting the smell of cigarette smoke fill his mouth. "To deal with the Koreans, we have to deal with the consortium. We have to deal with both the white and the black."

As Zhao An entered the Bai family's gate, hugging Qian Yuling, everyone's eyes were immediately drawn to him. The man was talented, the woman beautiful, and they immediately attracted countless glances.

"Yes, much better. We need to properly handle what just happened. Everyone in the family needs a blood test. No room for sloppiness. You'll do it yourself and supervise it. After the New Year, hold a meeting with the other three families. It's time to teach those brats a lesson." Old Madam Lin was furious that a branch of her family's bloodline had been tainted again.
"I'll provide the information, and you guys handle the sales and stuff. I'll take 70% and you'll take 30%. Any objections?" Zhao An took a sip from his teacup, a hint of amusement in his eyes.
"Hello, Mr. Bai, I've heard a lot about you!" Zhao An added politely. "I'm here just to visit and meet you."

"By the way, a Korean-born member of the Lin family just appeared in the Lin family. Have you tested them?" Zhao An suddenly thought of something amusing. What would happen to those with other people's blood? What would be their fate?

"Young Master Bai, nice to meet you." Zhao An took out a cigarette, handed one to each of them, lit it, and blew out a smoke ring. "I personally have no interest in making money. No matter how much money you make, it's just a number."
The underlying meaning is that if the other party goes too far, then use some shady methods. Explosions, assassinations, arson—all are possible.
Lin Yuanyuan shook her head. "He said he doesn't want it, and he also said he shouldn't tell anyone about his cancer treatment. He doesn't want to treat others."

"So I'm not interested in the pharmaceutical industry. India's generic drugs are so effective, and no one's regulating them. I have no interest in developing new drugs," Zhao An casually said. "If the R&D companies can't make money, no one will develop new drugs anymore. It's a slow death."
"Zhao An, nice to meet you. I'm Bai Qingyang." A tall, handsome man stepped forward and extended his hand. He was the very image of a girl's ideal prince charming!
"The distribution of benefits is indeed a bit problematic, but if it's you, then it's acceptable. You're worth the price, and others aren't," Bai Qingyang said with a smile.
"Okay, back to the previous question. Are you planning to make money with the leukemia drug?" Bai Qingyang continued. It's a patented drug!

"Very well, please take a seat. You are so imposing, truly a dragon among men. Please take a seat. Tea, good tea!" Bai Song was a well-off, middle-aged man with a long beard and a rather ancient look. His demeanor was a touch wise, revealing him to be a seasoned veteran.

"Haha, that's true. He looks like a playboy. Okay, Xiaoyuan, spend more time with him. It'll benefit you in the future." Madam Lin closed her eyes and prepared for sleep, taking a nap to regain her energy.
